description: The bar chart illustrates the performance scores of three different models—SRPO-7B, GRPO-7B, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B—across three benchmark categories: MathVista, MathVerse, and Physics. The vertical axis represents the score, ranging from 35 to 80, while the horizontal axis lists the benchmark categories. Each benchmark has three grouped bars, with SRPO-7B represented by a dark blue bar, GRPO-7B by a medium blue bar, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B by a light blue bar. In the MathVista benchmark, SRPO-7B achieves the highest score of 75.8, followed by GRPO-7B at 72.3, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B at 68.2. In the MathVerse benchmark, SRPO-7B scores 55.8, GRPO-7B scores 52.9, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 46.3. In the Physics benchmark, SRPO-7B scores 60.6, GRPO-7B scores 53.5, and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B scores 45.4. The chart indicates that SRPO-7B consistently outperforms the other two models across all benchmarks.
